APPROVE
The loop body moves into `JudgeExpressCall` and `ResolveRoute` with the same checks in the same order and the same results. `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` on the nullable tuple returns null exactly where the old code hit `continue`, so `ExpressAndFastify` falls well under 15 and should compile. I reviewed only the diff and did not build the project to confirm the type names.
